name: POS Quantity Based Discount
description: POS Discount per Quantity allows you to define discount rules per product, so your POS automatically applies the correct discount based on the number of units sold.
summary:
POS Discount per Quantity is a powerful Odoo module designed to make discount management in the Point of Sale more intelligent and automated. It enables businesses to configure quantity-based discount rules for each product, allowing the POS system to automatically apply the correct discount depending on the number of units sold. With this module, you can easily create flexible pricing strategies such as “Buy 5 items and get 5% off” or “Buy 10 items and get 10% off.” Each product can have its own unique discount tiers, giving retailers the ability to reward customers for bulk purchases while maintaining control over pricing and profitability. The feature integrates seamlessly with the existing POS interface - discounts are applied instantly as quantities change, without requiring manual entry from the cashier. The applied discount is clearly displayed on the order line and reflected on printed receipts, ensuring full transparency for both staff and customers. This module is ideal for retail stores, supermarkets, wholesalers, and any business that wants to encourage larger order sizes through smart, automated discounts directly in Odoo POS. It helps boost sales efficiency, improve customer satisfaction, and simplify discount administration.
